findings.summary: M18.269 closed with the changesets leg still red, and no row will turn it green. The row's acceptance allowed 'names only a reasoned gap', and that is what happened. But m18-complete counts a leg that names a gap as FAIL, so M18.43's 'unchanged completion gate success' cannot be met by any remaining row. changesetGaps counts any path under `${dir}/src/`, tests included, and @fluxion/layout's only change in range is a test file that ships nothing (files: ['dist']). That leaves three ways out: a no-op patch changeset that releases an unchanged package, an edit to the gate made under closeout pressure, or a leg left red. None of them should be decided at M18.43.
